item.title: DevPulse 0.17.0
item.description:
• See the tickets you created that are in a status of your choice, In Review by default, whoever works on them: their own section "Created by me · In Review" in the menu bar window, and panel 5 in the terminal dashboard. Set it in Settings › Jira (Show tickets I created, In status; several statuses separated by commas).
  • A notification when a ticket you created reaches one of those statuses; switch it off in Settings › Notifications › Jira.
